confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately certain. Draught beer is rarely served on tap in Egypt, so the anchor reflects a bottled 0.5 L local beer. Cocktail, wine, and hotel anchors are less certain and depend on resort season and EGP exchange-rate movements. The FX observation (RBA, 2026-10-15) came from a figure in search-result summary text attributed to the RBA homepage, which I did not open directly. Other search results showed a different third-party figure (0.6947) and a market quote (0.6924), which I did not use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Egyptian Red Sea resort towns, mainly Hurghada and Dahab, with Sharm El Sheikh's Naama Bay-area hotel and bar prices adjusted upward. July is treated as a hot, lower-demand period for Western tourism, with a mix of domestic and regional visitors.
